dashboard.name: Strata
dashboard.intro: How fit each source is to support answers. These are the same measures as the Data readiness page in Strata. Pick a measure date to compare the two.
dashboard.measureDateAbout: Every tile shows the newest measures taken on or before this date. It starts on today's date.
dashboard.headline: What the measures say
dashboard.headlineAbout: The day's headline, written by the same code as the Data readiness page in Strata.
dashboard.awardRows: Contract-award rows per fiscal year, by dataset
dashboard.awardRowsAbout: Rows per fiscal year. Each awards dataset's rows are counted as the Coverage column in Strata counts them, one for each joint-venture member. The award notices for fiscal 2017 to 2019 count one row for each contract, because Strata shows those years as a Gap with no count. A missing bar means no rows.
dashboard.sourceRows: Rows per fiscal year, by source
dashboard.sourceRowsAbout: Rows in each fiscal year for the contract awards, the procurement notices, the projects and the Independent Evaluation Group (IEG) ratings, with exact counts, then the documents I read of each type, by the fiscal year they were disclosed. Each source's rows are counted as its Coverage column in Strata counts them, so its years add up to that number on the same date. The award notices for fiscal 2017 to 2019 count one row for each contract. It is the table for the chart of contract-award rows.
dashboard.links: Share of rows that link, by link
dashboard.linksAbout: Each link with {fewest} rows or more, as the share of its rows that link. The table of freshness and link counts lists every link with its counts.
dashboard.routes: Share of pages read well, by route
dashboard.routesAbout: The share of pages each reading route read well, for routes with {fewest} pages or more. The routes are the published text and the layout parser, which reads scans and tables. The pages come from Procurement Plans and project reports.
dashboard.freshness: Freshness, links and pages read well, by source
dashboard.freshnessAbout: Each source's latest data, how often it updates, how late it is, its link counts and its status. The last rows give the Procurement Plan and project report pages each reading route read well. It is the table for the two charts of shares.
dashboard.fixes: Fixes ranked by what they would unlock
dashboard.fixesAbout: Ranked by how many projects each fix would add evidence to, as on the Data readiness page.
dashboard.projects: Projects it would add evidence to
dashboard.notes: Source: Strata's data readiness measures in strata.ops.
